lines.say: Why you blank on the ward round, when you knew it last night.
Last night, you looked over it, and it all made sense. That's recognition.
On the ward, you pull it out cold. That's recall.
So practise recall. Offload quizzes you on your own lecture notes.
It plans when, and brings each topic back before you forget.
You just click the link in your calendar and show up.
